description: Scenario tests for tiktok-growth. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-growth-system
evals.input: My TikTok isn't growing. I post a few times a week about my SaaS. Help me grow.
expect: reads brand-profile, social-strategy, and audience first
diagnoses which stage/phase of the test-and-expand loop is stuck
centers completion rate (70%+) and rewatches as the dominant signals, with a 1-second hook
routes fixes to the right skills (tiktok-script, hook-writer, profile-optimization, content-calendar, etc.)
ties cadence to sustainable consistency and judges progress via native TikTok analytics, not WoopSocial analytics

evals.name: diagnose-phase-1-death
evals.input: My videos get like 200 views and then stop. What's happening?
expect: explains the video is dying in the Phase-1 test audience (low watch time/completion in the first window)
identifies the fix as a stronger 1-second hook and higher completion (faster pacing, a loop)
routes to tiktok-script / hook-writer rather than telling them to post more or get more followers

evals.name: completion-and-rewatch-lever
evals.input: How do I actually get a video to take off on TikTok?
expect: emphasizes completion rate (aim ~70%+) and rewatches/loops as the top signals
advises a 1-second hook, fast pacing, and a loop/rewatch trigger
notes likes are the weakest signal and not the goal

evals.name: search-pillar
evals.input: How do I get found on TikTok beyond just hoping for the FYP?
expect: treats TikTok search/SEO as a major evergreen growth pillar (TikTok is a search engine)
advises keywords in spoken audio, on-screen text, and caption (the triple mention)
routes to hashtag-strategy / social-seo and tiktok-script for the keyword layer

evals.name: followers-are-business-not-reach-pushback
evals.input: I just need more followers so my videos get more reach. Can I buy some?
expect: refuses buying followers / fake engagement (hurts performance, risks the account)
explains follower count is not a TikTok ranking factor — reach comes from content performance, not followers
reframes followers as a business asset (LIVE/Shop/owned audience/community) and points to completion + search as the reach levers

evals.name: volume-and-patterns
evals.input: I posted one video that flopped, so the algorithm must hate me.
expect: reframes growth as consistent at-bats where each post is a cheap test (and videos can resurface later)
advises judging by patterns across many videos, not a single one (e.g., which hooks repeatedly land)
recommends a sustainable consistent cadence rather than quitting after one flop

evals.name: native-features-and-series
evals.input: What TikTok features should I use to grow faster?
expect: recommends relevant native features: Stitch/Duet for piggybacking reach, Series/Parts to drive binge + follows, pinned comment to seed conversation
notes LIVE requires ~1,000 followers and is a community/monetization tool, not an early-growth reach lever
ties feature choice to the user's stage rather than listing everything

evals.name: niche-and-no-analytics
evals.input: I post about marketing, gaming, and cooking. How do I know what's working?
expect: advises tightening to a clear niche so TikTok's interest graph can categorize and recommend the account
does not claim WoopSocial provides analytics
points to native TikTok analytics (completion, rewatch, shares, traffic source FYP vs Search vs Profile, follower conversion) and notes a business/creator account is needed
